XE2WT Inappropriate material identified in device Problems that occur due to the presence of a material that should not be present or part of the device. XE60T Inadequate physicochemical properties identified in device Problems that occur due to the physicochemical properties. XE4EB Incompatible material identified in device Problems that occur due to the incompatibility of materials that co-exist simultaneously as part of the device. XE25Z Reactivity problem identified with device Problems that occur due to the reactivity of materials (e.g. over-react or under- react).

XE640.title: Mechanical problem with device identified
XE640.definition: Problems that result from internal or external forces including fluids, other objects, or environmental or physiologic influences. XE8RU Device migration identified A device that has moved from its original location due to external forces (e.g. stent or lead movement). XE3HZ Friction problem identified with device Problems caused by its surface coming in contact with another surface or fluid. XE1P8 Leakage or seal problem identified with device Problems caused by inadequate/broken seal within the device. XE6UT Lubrication problem identified with device Problems that occurred because of the presence of either too much or too little lubricant where required (e.g. connectors, leading to failure mechanisms such as corrosion). XE69Q Stiffness problem identified with device Problems caused by either excessive or inadequate physical force exerted on it by another object resulting in problems e.g. wear, bending, deformation, fracture, fatigue. XE8V5 Stress problem with device identified Problems caused by either excessive or inadequate physical force exerted on it by another object resulting in problems e.g. wear, bending, deformation, fracture, fatigue. XE0WG Deformation problem with device identified Problems caused by changes in the shape or size of the device due to an applied force. This can be a result of tensile forces, compressive forces, shear, bending, tensile (pulling), or torsion. XE3Y4 Fatigue problem with device identified Problems due to the weakening or breakdown of its material when subjected to stress or a series of repeated stresses. XE1ZP Fracture problem with device identified Problems caused by the separation of a component, object, or material into two or more pieces including shear. XE1UJ Mechanical shock problem with device identified Problems caused by the sudden violent blow or collision to the whole device (e.g. by dropping).

XE4KN.title: Optical problem with device identified
XE4KN.definition: Problems related to the optical properties of a device. XE42B Optical transmission problem identified with device Problems with the device's ability to pass light energy. XE8XT Light source problem identified with device Problems with the optical properties of a device such as diopter, glare, and irradiance or glistening.

XE05W.title: Clinical imaging problem with device identified
XE05W.definition: Problems that occur with devices used for radiographic or imaging procedures e.g. CT scanners, magnetic resonance imaging. XE15N Gradient induced field problem with device identified Problems that result from the gradient-induced fields generated during radiologic procedures e.g. magnetic resonance imaging. XE1HK Image artifact identified in device The unacceptable distortion of an image due to signal loss that may occur during a radiologic procedure such as magnetic resonance imaging. XE6YW Magnetically-induced movement of device identified Problems due to unintended or excessive movement created by the application of magnetic fields. XE9Y9 Radiofrequency induced overheating of device identified Problems due to unintended radiofrequency-induced temperature increase that can occur in the vicinity of the device.

XE6TE.title: Software problem with device identified
XE6TE.definition: Problems related to the device software. XE77W Configuration issue of device identified Problems due to change control or incorrect version, including regional requirements.

XE8XM.title: Thermal problem with device identified
XE8XM.definition: Problems related to the temperature of the device.
exclusions: Problems related to environmental temperature identified
The device was found to become hotter than expected during operation. This
applies to devices which are not intended to deliver heat.
Use "Excessive heating identified" for devices which are intended to deliver heat
Overheating of devices intended to deliver heat during
Excessive heating of device problem identified

XE5HU.title: Protective system problem with device identified
XE5HU.definition: Problems related to the system(s) designed to prevent or warn about unsafe operation of the device. XE0WJ Fail-safe problem with device identified A system intended to prevent unsafe operation of the device did not operate correctly. XE4JQ Alarm system problem with device identified A system intended to warn of a potentially unsafe condition did not operate correctly. XE7ZT Problem of device to self-test identified Malfunction of the device's self-test system. XE1JG Problem of device to auto stop identified An auto stop function of a device did not operate correctly. XE9AV Reset problem with device identified The device does not reset properly.

XE82X.title: Operational problem with device identified
XE82X.definition: Problems that occur during the performance, use, or functioning of the device. XE5RS Device incorrectly reprocessed Problems associated with the failure to properly and adequately reprocess the device. XE2RQ Device incorrectly cleaned during reprocessing identified The cleaning procedure is not followed correctly or used inappropriate cleaning materials. XE63T Device incorrectly disinfected or sterilised during reprocessing identified The disinfection or sterilization process was incorrect or the wrong products for disinfection or sterilization were used. XE0TU Device incorrectly assembled during reprocessing identified Incorrect assembly of the device following reprocessing. XE15Q Failure to calibrate problem identified A device that cannot calibrate (establish the relationship between a measuring device and the units of measure) to ensure accurate readings. XE3W1 Device difficult to operate problem identified Problems including set-up, operation, and disassembly of equipment. Not including reprocessing. XE2QD Incorrect interpretation of results or data problem identified Problems resulting from the incorrect interpretation by the user of the results or data provided by the device.

XE2YD.title: Patient sample problem with device identified
XE2YD.definition: Problems that occurred due to endogenous or exogenous interferent in the sample, or unexpected variation in the target analyte/marker. XE8DL New or unknown interferent problem with device identified New or unknown endogenous or exogenous interferent (sample) identified. XE9C0 Known interferent problem with device identified Known interferent in the sample identified.

XE3AL.title: Environment problem with device identified
XE3AL.definition: Problems that occurred due to factors within the environment e.g. dust, dirt, humidity, temperature. XE5K2 Environmental temperature problem with device identified Device performance was affected by the temperature, or changes in temperature, of the environment in which it was used. XE9HK Dust or dirt problem with device identified A device that experienced problems due to ingress, or coating, of dust or dirt. XE2VF Contamination of environment by device identified Operation of the device results in contamination of the nearby environment e.g. dust, dirt, smoke, heat or biological material. XE6QW Environmental pressure problem with device identified Device performance was affected by the pressure, or changes in pressure, of the environment in which it was used. XE5SF Ambient light problem with device identified Device performance was affected by ambient light. This term applies to the direct effects of ambient light on the device, and to the user's ability to operate the device (e.g. to read device output). XE4V1 Environmental humidity problem with device identified Device performance was affected by the humidity, or changes in humidity, of the environment in which it was used.

XE205.title: Manufacturing process problem with device identified
XE205.definition: Problems with a device that can be traced to a problem in the manufacturing and/or production process. XE3NF Assembly problem with device identified Problems that occurred because the device was assembled incorrectly. XE00F Sterilization problem with device identified Problems that occurred during terminal sterilization by the manufacturer. XE1PG Installation problem with device identified A device that malfunctions because it was incorrectly installed, set up, or configured (E.g. misconfiguration of an "automatic" defibrillator to "semi-automatic", thereby leading to failure). XE843 Maintenance of manufacturing machinery problem with device identified Problems caused by failure to maintain manufacturing equipment used to produce the device.

XE6LZ.title: Maintenance problem with device identified
XE6LZ.definition: A device malfunction or problem that occurs after production because the device was not properly maintained according to the instructions (e.g. maintenance may be performed by user facility, distributor, or service provider).

XE9VK.title: Transport or storage problem with device identified
XE9VK.definition: Problems caused by transport or storage conditions. XE32G Storage of device problem identified Problems that result from storing the device in an uncontrolled or improper environment (e.g. moisture sensitive devices stored in a humid environment).

XE41R.title: No device problem found
XE41R.definition: The device either functioned as intended or a problem was not found.

XE587.title: No findings available
XE587.definition: Use when no investigation can be performed and therefore no results will be obtained.

XE3PA.title: Results pending completion of investigation
XE3PA.definition: Investigation is ongoing and results are not yet available. Do not use this code if the investigation is complete.

XE3WR.title: Appropriate term or code for investigation of device not available
XE3WR.definition: Problems not adequately described by any other term.

XE9HD.title: Testing of actual or suspected device
XE9HD.definition: The investigation employed relevant empirical testing of the actual device suspected in the reported adverse event in order to establish their functional and other properties and to identify possible causes for the adverse event. Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the latest relevant standards.

XE7XH.title: Testing of device from same lot or batch retained by manufacturer
XE7XH.definition: The investigation employed relevant empirical testing of the device of the same lot or batch as that of the suspected device in the reported adverse event in order to support the identification of possible causes for the adverse event. Testing was performed using the device retained by the manufacturer (i.e. was not shipped). Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the latest relevant standards.

XE4S0.title: Testing of device from same lot batch returned from user
XE4S0.definition: The investigation employed relevant empirical testing of the device of the same lot or batch as that of the suspected device in the reported adverse event in order to support the identification of possible causes for the adverse event. The device was returned from the user. Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the latest relevant standards.

XE2ZR.title: Testing of device from other lot batch retained by manufacturer
XE2ZR.definition: The investigation employed relevant empirical testing of the device of another lot or batch than that of the suspected device in the reported adverse event in order to support the identification of possible causes for the adverse event. This includes devices without a lot/batch designation. Testing was performed using the device retained by the manufacturer (i.e. was not shipped). Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the latest relevant standards.

XE4X1.title: Testing of device from other lot or batch returned from user
XE4X1.definition: The investigation employed relevant empirical testing of the device of another lot or batch than that of the suspected device in the reported adverse event in order to support the identification of possible causes for the adverse event. This includes devices without a lot/batch designation. The device was returned from the user. Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the technical file. Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the latest relevant standards.

XE1XT.title: Testing of model variant
XE1XT.definition: The investigation employed relevant empirical testing of a model variant of the device involved in the reported adverse event in order to support the identification of possible causes for the adverse event through plausibility reasoning. A model variant is not identical to the actual device, but shares relevant characteristics with the device involved. Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the latest relevant standards.

XE8XV.title: Testing of raw or starting materials
XE8XV.definition: The investigation employed relevant empirical testing of the materials used in construction of the device involved in the reported adverse event in order to support the identification of possible causes for the adverse event. Relevant testing would typically be based on test methods used for evaluating safety and performance as described in the latest relevant standards.

XE8UH.title: Historical data analysis
XE8UH.definition: The investigation involved the analysis of historical adverse events data of the actual device involved in the adverse event and/or of products from the same and/or different batches/lots.

XE8BM.title: Trend analysis
XE8BM.definition: The investigation involved trend analysis of adverse event of the actual device involved in the adverse event and/or of products from the same and/or different batches/lots. It should be noted that trend analysis typically is not considered sufficient as a stand-alone method, but should be used in conjunction with other investigation methods for providing for instance complementary information.

XE7GK.title: Communication or interviews
XE7GK.definition: The investigation involved communication/interviews (either interpersonal or through technical means, e.g. phone, e-mail) with persons close to the adverse event, e.g. healthcare professionals (doctors, nurses etc.), the affected patient(s) or other users including, where appropriate, relatives or others engaged in caring for the affected patient.

XE4KV.title: Analysis of production records
XE4KV.definition: The investigation involved the analysis of relevant production records in view of supporting the identification of possible causes for the adverse event.

XE59M.title: Analysis of data provided by user or third party
XE59M.definition: The investigation involved the analysis of relevant data provided by the user (e.g. healthcare professional, patient, clinical engineer) or a third party (e.g. testing facility) in view of supporting the identification of possible causes for the adverse event.

XE8FB.title: Device not manufactured by reporting manufacturer
XE8FB.definition: Further information was obtained which established that the manufacturer of the device involved was not the one to which it was initially attributed.

XE970.title: Device not returned
XE970.definition: The actual device involved in the adverse event was not returned for testing despite requests by manufacturer.

XE18W.title: Device discarded
XE18W.definition: The actual device involved in the adverse event had been already discarded and thus irretrievably lost for testing.

XE5AN.title: Incomplete device returned
XE5AN.definition: The device was returned incompletely, lacking parts, components or accessories that would be required for appropriate testing and analysis of root causes.

XE53L.title: Device not accessible for testing
XE53L.definition: The actual device involved in the adverse event is not readily accessible for testing (e.g. remains implanted in patient).

XE6Q2.title: Type of investigation not yet determined
XE6Q2.definition: Details to determine the type of investigation are not yet available, but are being sought. Do not use this code if the investigation is complete.

XE3TW.title: Insufficient information available
XE3TW.definition: The information available relating to the reported event is not sufficient to identify either the manufacturer, the device, or other essential information. This term indicates that no further investigation is possible. Do not use this code if further information is being sought, instead use ''Type of investigation not yet determined''. Medical device component Terms/codes for describing the parts and components which were involved in, or affected by, the medical device adverse event/incident. Biological and chemical medical device component Component whose mode of action involves a biological process (e.g. test strip which acts on antibodies) and chemical reaction or transformation (e.g. activated charcoal absorber).

XE8XD.title: Absorber component of medical device
XE8XD.definition: A component or material designed to take in or attenuate a substance.

XE6Z7.title: Cautery tip component of medical device
XE6Z7.definition: A component designed to coagulate and seal blood vessels or to destroy tissue with heat or electric current.

XE7JR.title: Device ingredient or reagent component of medical device
XE7JR.definition: A consumable material that is added to a device and is used to make a finished product or becomes part of a finished product.

XE8HT.title: Gas scavenging component of medical device
XE8HT.definition: A component designed to remove certain gases from a gas stream or environment.

XE4VK.title: Monomer liquid component of medical device
XE4VK.definition: The liquid that reacts with the polymer powder to form adhesive, resin, or cement.

XE68H.title: Test strip component of medical device
XE68H.definition: A piece of chemically treated medium designed to react in the presence of specific amounts of a trigger substance.

XE7WP.title: Polymer powder component of medical device
XE7WP.definition: The powder that reacts with the monomer liquid to form adhesive, resin, or cement.

XE321.title: Antenna component of medical device
XE321.definition: A component designed to transmit or receive electromagnetic signals.

XE3WM.title: Battery component of medical device
XE3WM.definition: A component designed to produce an electric current through chemical reaction.

XE80Z.title: Battery charger component of medical device
XE80Z.definition: A device designed to restore the capacity of a battery.

XE7JQ.title: Cable, electrical component of medical device
XE7JQ.definition: A long, thin, multistranded electrical wire designed to carry signals or power over a distance. XE77B Cable grip component of medical device Component used for tensioning, pulling or stringing of wires and cables. XE2BS Cable sleeve component of medical device Component used to protect cables and wires from abrasion, moisture and the elements.

XE2WY.title: Circuit board component of medical device
XE2WY.definition: A non-conducting board with conductive tracks and electronic components forming a circuit.

XE5BT.title: Circuit breaker component of medical device
XE5BT.definition: A component designed to open an electrical circuit when it becomes overloaded.

XE2ZE.title: Computer hardware component of medical device
XE2ZE.definition: The physical components from which a computer is constructed (electronic circuits and input/output devices). XE3Q8 Computer processor component of medical device Component that carries out the instructions of a computer program by performing the basic arithmetic, logic, controlling, and input/output operations specified by the instructions. XE1JS Memory or storage component of medical device Any component that can hold data in machine-readable format. XE2YC Network interface component of medical device Point of interconnection between a computer and other computer that are linked each other.

XE8UU.title: Computer software component of medical device
XE8UU.definition: A collection of data or computer instructions that tell the computer how to work. XE59Z Computer software driver component of medical device A computer interface designed to control the interaction between a CPU and a peripheral device. XE2JQ Software interface component of medical device Languages, codes and messages that programs use to communicate with each other and to the hardware. XE8V6 User interface component of medical device A computer program that controls the interaction between a user and a system.

XE7P0.title: Cooling module component of medical device
XE7P0.definition: A component designed to lower the temperature of a device or system.

XE8UV.title: Device programmer component of medical device
XE8UV.definition: A piece of hardware for transferring data onto programmable integrated circuits.

XE033.title: Device reader component of medical device
XE033.definition: A piece of hardware used to read the memory and the properties of a device.

XE6UE.title: Discrete electrical component of medical device
XE6UE.definition: An electrical component which is just one circuit, either passive or active, that is not an integrated circuit. XE845 Electrical capacitor component of medical device An electrical component designed to store an electric charge. XE38E Electrical fuse component of medical device An electrical component designed to stop the flow of current when an overload condition exists. XE1UQ Electrical inductor component of medical device A component designed to introduce electromotive force to a circuit, usually a coil surrounding a wire. XE2AJ Electrical resistor component of medical device An electronic component that opposes the flow of current. XE4VJ Electrical solenoid component of medical device An electronic component consisting of a coil surrounding a movable iron core that is designed to act as a switch or relay. XE018 Electrical transducer component of medical device An electrical component that converts one form of energy into another.

XE9ZW.title: Integrated circuit chip component of medical device
XE9ZW.definition: A microelectronic circuit that incorporates many interconnected transistors and other components.

XE8GY.title: Display component of medical device
XE8GY.definition: A component designed to present information visually.
exclusions: Display indicator component of medical device
A component designed to show an operating condition of a system or to attract
Display screen component of medical device
A panel or area on an electronic device where images and data are displayed.

XE59E.title: Electrical lead or wire component of medical device
XE59E.definition: A coated or uncoated wire used to connect two locations electronically. Not to be used for patient connection. XE5U9 Electrode component of medical device A small piece of metal or other conductive substance that is used to take an electric current to or from a source of power, a piece of equipment. Not to be used for patient connection. XE561 Ground strap or wire component of medical device A wire cable or strap designed to carry current safely away from an electronic device under fault condition XE753 Wiring harness component of medical device A collection of grouped wires or cables designed to connect to a specific device.

XE6S4.title: Electrical mixer component of medical device
XE6S4.definition: An electronic component designed to blend signals.

XE0Y5.title: Electrical port component of medical device
XE0Y5.definition: An electronic circuit that acts as a connection to another device or component.

XE2PX.title: Emitter component of medical device
XE2PX.definition: The electron source electrode in a transistor or any source in a system.

XE5GC.title: Headphone or headset component of medical device
XE5GC.definition: A component that covers the ear through which you can listen without other people hearing. Some headphones come with a microphone which is used to communicate with other people or the device.

XE9TB.title: Heater component of medical device
XE9TB.definition: A piece of equipment used to raise the temperature of air, gas or water or an object.

XE713.title: Hub component of medical device
XE713.definition: An electronic component designed as a central connection for other devices or components.

XE8JV.title: Inverter component of medical device
XE8JV.definition: An electrical component that converts direct current to alternating current.

XE4BN.title: Magnet component of medical device
XE4BN.definition: A component that attracts iron and produces a magnetic field.

XE7YS.title: Oscillator component of medical device
XE7YS.definition: An electronic component designed to produce a wave signal.

XE525.title: Patient lead component of medical device
XE525.definition: An insulated electrical cable designed to connect to an electrical device to a patient. XE7F1 Lead conductor component of medical device A cable designed to conduct electricity from the device to the lead. XE25C Patient electrode component of medical device An electrical conductor that is designed to make contact with a patient including defibrillator paddles.

XE4XJ.title: Power cord component of medical device
XE4XJ.definition: A flexible cable designed to connect an electrical device to a power outlet.

XE4Q4.title: Power supply component of medical device
XE4Q4.definition: Component designed to supply electrical power to devices.

XE7EJ.title: Pressure transducer probe component of medical device
XE7EJ.definition: A probe component designed to convert a change in pressure into a varying electrical signal.

XE062.title: Printer component of medical device
XE062.definition: An electronic component that is designed to transfer text or images to paper or other substrate.

XE2KA.title: Receiver component of medical device
XE2KA.definition: An electronic component designed to capture an incoming electromagnetic signal and convert it to an audible or visual signal.

XE6SG.title: Receiver stimulator unit component of medical device
XE6SG.definition: As part of a cochlear implant, an implanted component designed to receive signal from the external component and then decode the signal and transmit it to the brain.

XE4TH.title: Scanner component of medical device
XE4TH.definition: An electronic component that generates a digital representation of an image for data input to a computer; or a receiver designed to search for a signal within a specified frequency range.

XE0ST.title: Speaker or sounder component of medical device
XE0ST.definition: A component designed to convert electrical signals to sounds that can be heard.

XE5R5.title: Switch or relay component of medical device
XE5R5.definition: A mechanical or electronic component designed to break or change the connections in a circuit (e.g. button). XE1EF Power switch component of medical device A switch designed to regulate the power to a device. XE4QR Relay component of medical device A electronic component designed to break or change the connections in a circuit.

XE884.title: Telemetry component of medical device
XE884.definition: Component designed to transmit and receive data from a remote source using telecommunications methods.

XE30P.title: Temperature compensator component of medical device
XE30P.definition: A component designed to compensate the temperature of one system in response to temperature changes in another system or the environment.

XE56F.title: Thermostat component of medical device
XE56F.definition: A component designed to regulate temperature by controlling the starting and stopping of a heating/cooling system.

XE256.title: Transformer component of medical device
XE256.definition: A component that either steps up or steps down an alternating electrical current to an output that is suitable for another electrical device or component.

XE579.title: Transmitter component of medical device
XE579.definition: A component to propagate electromagnetic waves.

XE5A0.title: User input device component of medical device
XE5A0.definition: A component that uses a movable handle to create two-axis input to a computer. XE9TZ Joystick component of medical device A control component that uses a movable handle to create two-axis input to a computer. XE6CN Keyboard or keypad component of medical device A component consisting of mechanical keys that are pressed to create input to a computer.

XE37A.title: Analyzer component of medical device
XE37A.definition: Any component designed to perform an analysis. XE0A7 Oxygen analyzer component of medical device A component designed to measure the concentration of oxygen in a gas mixture.

XE6E8.title: Aperture component of medical device
XE6E8.definition: An instrument designed to measure the size of an opening or one used to increase the diameter of an opening.

XE34X.title: Calibrator component of medical device
XE34X.definition: A standard or reference material used to set the operating parameters of an instrument.

XE06B.title: Clock component of medical device
XE06B.definition: A component designed to indicate the time of day.

XE9NB.title: Counter component of medical device
XE9NB.definition: A component designed to keep track of the number of times something happens.

XE20X.title: Curvette component of medical device
XE20X.definition: A clear container designed to interface with an optical sensor in order to obtain an optical measurement of a contained substance.

XE00B.title: Gauges or meters component of medical device
XE00B.definition: A component designed to give a visual indication of the condition of a system. XE1WJ Flowmeter component of medical device A component designed to measure the flow rate of a fluid. XE6V2 Manometer component of medical device A component designed to measure pressure. XE019 Thermometer component of medical device A component designed to measure temperature.

XE8RD.title: Marker component of medical device
XE8RD.definition: A visual indicator of position, place or route, including radiopaque markers.

XE7MS.title: Pipette component of medical device
XE7MS.definition: A measuring component, traditionally including a graduated tube, designed for the accurate transfer of liquid volumes.

XE5UB.title: Pointer component of medical device
XE5UB.definition: An indicator component designed to show a position on a scale.

XE2MH.title: Scale component of medical device
XE2MH.definition: A component designed for weighing or an indicator component with a graduated sequence of divisions.

XE8GP.title: Sensor component of medical device
XE8GP.definition: A component designed to respond to a stimulus by generating a signal that can be measured or interpreted. XE5Q2 Bubble sensor component of medical device A component designed to signal the presence of bubbles in a system. XE5ZD Oxygen sensor component of medical device A sensor designed to respond to the presence or level of oxygen in a space or environment. XE9G5 Photodetector component of medical device A component designed to detect light. XE5WR Pressure sensor component of medical device A sensor designed to respond to the level of pressure in a space or pressing on a surface. XE7Q4 Sensor probe component of medical device A component designed to reach into a location for sensing. Should be used when the problem involves the probe, not the sensor. XE3W9 Temperature sensor component of medical device A sensor designed to respond to the temperature of a space, surface, or environment.

XE3R3.title: Timer component of medical device
XE3R3.definition: A component designed to measure a time interval.

XE3UX.title: Access port component of medical device
XE3UX.definition: A component designed for the introduction or removal of medical equipment or any substance.

XE0WZ.title: Actuator component of medical device
XE0WZ.definition: A component which moves or controls a mechanism or system.

XE0SV.title: Adaptor component of medical device
XE0SV.definition: A component designed to make different pieces of apparatus compatible.

XE6D6.title: Air eliminator component of medical device
XE6D6.definition: A component designed to remove air from a space or fluid.

XE4F2.title: Anchor component of medical device
XE4F2.definition: A component designed to fix the device or a portion of the device in place.

XE94Y.title: Applicator component of medical device
XE94Y.definition: A component designed to transfer a substance to a surface.

XE968.title: Automatic injection system component of medical device
XE968.definition: A system designed to pump a gas or liquid into a space or environment without outside intervention.

XE7E4.title: Bag component of medical device
XE7E4.definition: A flexible container, often with a single opening.

XE0HN.title: Ball component of medical device
XE0HN.definition: Any component that is spherical in shape.

XE5AV.title: Balloon component of medical device
XE5AV.definition: A sac designed to be inflated and deflated.

XE1G8.title: Bearings component of medical device
XE1G8.definition: A point of contact between moving parts designed for support or to reduce friction.

XE0Y2.title: Potting component of medical device
XE0Y2.definition: The resin, glue or other substance used to seal other components together.

XE46S.title: Probe component of medical device
XE46S.definition: A component designed to reach into a location for manipulating or for measuring.

XE23M.title: Processor component of medical device
XE23M.definition: A component designed for preparing or treating a material. Should not be used for computer processors.
exclusions: Computer processor component of medical device (XE3Q8)

XE9DJ.title: Pulley component of medical device
XE9DJ.definition: A component which changes the direction of a force (e.g. belt or chain).

XE0K1.title: Pump component of medical device
XE0K1.definition: A component designed to facilitate the movement of a fluid.

XE8RF.title: Pusher component of medical device
XE8RF.definition: A component designed to advance something by pushing it.

XE76K.title: Rachet component of medical device
XE76K.definition: A part that allows or forces another part's movement in a single direction.

XE4JZ.title: Rail component of medical device
XE4JZ.definition: A bar designed for support, attachment, guidance, or protection from falling. XE0KN Side rail component of medical device A supportive or protective rail attached to the side of something.

XE6YN.title: Regulator component of medical device
XE6YN.definition: A component designed to control a process or condition.

XE1XK.title: Bellows component of medical device
XE1XK.definition: A component that expands and contracts to draw in air through a valve or orifice and expels it through a tube.

XE017.title: Rod or shaft component of medical device
XE017.definition: A long cylindrical bar used to transmit motion or connect other components.

XE4BJ.title: Seal component of medical device
XE4BJ.definition: A component designed to prevent passage of material through a joint or opening.

XE7N2.title: Shock absorber component of medical device
XE7N2.definition: A mechanical component designed to dampen or attenuate a force.

XE7ZG.title: Sleeve component of medical device
XE7ZG.definition: A cylindrical fitting that slides over another part of a device or other object.

XE6VJ.title: Slide component of medical device
XE6VJ.definition: A flat rectangular piece of glass on which specimens can be mounted for microscopic study.

XE740.title: Socket component of medical device
XE740.definition: A component designed as an opening into which something else fits.

XE4DU.title: Spacer component of medical device
XE4DU.definition: A component designed to position objects further apart.

XE7QZ.title: Spring component of medical device
XE7QZ.definition: An elastic component designed to bend under a load and then return to its shape when unloaded.

XE4K0.title: Stand component of medical device
XE4K0.definition: A support component designed to hold an object.

XE9CF.title: Belt component of medical device
XE9CF.definition: A component consisting of a narrow band of material moving over shafts or pulleys.

XE82E.title: Steering wire component of medical device
XE82E.definition: A wire designed to enable a device to be maneuvered.

XE7UE.title: Stent component of medical device
XE7UE.definition: Tubular support placed inside a blood vessel, canal, or duct to aid healing or relieve an obstruction.

XE8M4.title: Stopcock component of medical device
XE8M4.definition: A rotating component designed to act like a tap for regulating the flow of a fluid, and to completely stop the flow when closed fully.

XE4E4.title: Strain relief component of medical device
XE4E4.definition: A structure designed to function with a connector to prevent damage to a hose or cable from excess flexing.

XE3GN.title: Stylet component of medical device
XE3GN.definition: A thin metal wire designed to be passed through a needle, catheter, or cannula to stiffen it or clear it of debris.

XE05P.title: Syringe component of medical device
XE05P.definition: A component designed as a rigid cylinder with a plunger at one end and a delivery opening at the other.

XE3ED.title: Table component of medical device
XE3ED.definition: A component having a smooth flat surface that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs.

XE6GE.title: Tool component of medical device
XE6GE.definition: A component that is delivered with a device to support its assembly or operation, and is not part of the device. Use only in the case there are no other terms to describe the component.

XE7G4.title: Bottle component of medical device
XE7G4.definition: A rigid or semi-rigid container used to store liquid.

XE0UG.title: Translational motion component of medical device
XE0UG.definition: A rotating part which is intended to transfer rotational movement or motion to another type of movement (e.g. excenters).

XE2FM.title: Trap component of medical device
XE2FM.definition: A component designed to capture or remove bubbles or fluid.

XE4M3.title: Trocar component of medical device
XE4M3.definition: A sharp, pointed rod designed to pierce the wall of a body cavity to withdraw fluid or allow placement of a catheter or other device.

XE8TY.title: Tube component of medical device
XE8TY.definition: A long hollow cylinder, either rigid or flexible, for holding or transporting liquids or gasses. XE2PZ Capillary tube component of medical device A narrow tube in which a liquid flows up against gravity.

XE01P.title: Valve component of medical device
XE01P.definition: A mechanical component designed to control the flow of a fluid or gas. XE3YJ Control valve component of medical device A valve designed to regulate the flow of a fluid or gas. XE229 Luer valve component of medical device A valve that incorporates a Luer fitting. XE2LS One-way valve component of medical device A valve designed to allow flow in only one direction.

XE6MT.title: Vaporiser component of medical device
XE6MT.definition: A component for gasifying liquids such as drugs.

XE0FP.title: Vibrator component of medical device
XE0FP.definition: A mechanical component designed to create a vibratory motion.

XE83A.title: Washer component of medical device
XE83A.definition: A flattened disk used as a mechanical seal between objects.

XE1PW.title: Weld component of medical device
XE1PW.definition: Any joining connection that is the result of welding 2 or more parts.

XE6HA.title: Wheel component of medical device
XE6HA.definition: A mechanical component consisting of a spoked, circular rim or solid disk designed to rotate on an axle or shaft.

XE0C3.title: Breathing circuit component of medical device
XE0C3.definition: In an anesthesia machine, the pathway by which a gaseous anesthetic agent and oxygen are delivered to the patient and carbon dioxide is removed. The circuit can be open or closed.

XE99Z.title: Window component of medical device
XE99Z.definition: A transparent panel in a device designed for visual inspection or to let light pass.

XE2Q3.title: Shutter component of medical device
XE2Q3.definition: Aperture that controls or blocks light or radiation passing through.

XE5YT.title: Brush component of medical device
XE5YT.definition: A component consisting of hairs or bristles set into a handle or holder.

XE0AX.title: Brushing component of medical device
XE0AX.definition: A cylindrical metal sleeve designed to reduce the friction of a rotating shaft.

XE4NU.title: Cable, mechanical structural component of medical device
XE4NU.definition: A long, thin, multistranded rope or metallic wire to hold the subject.

XE2UB.title: Cannula component of medical device
XE2UB.definition: A rigid or semi-rigid tube inserted into the body. XE9FK Cannula hub component of medical device A metal or plastic component that connects to the cannula.

XE44H.title: Cap component of medical device
XE44H.definition: A component designed to close an opening of a container or device.

XE00E.title: Carrier component of medical device
XE00E.definition: A component designed to facilitate the support, movement, or transport of another device or object.

XE3K0.title: Caster component of medical device
XE3K0.definition: A pivoting roller or wheel designed to attach to an object to make it movable.

XE088.title: Catheter component of medical device
XE088.definition: A flexible tube inserted into the body designed to permit injection or withdrawal of fluids or to keep passage open. XE8NS Catheter hub component of medical device A small metal or plastic component that connects to the catheter.

XE1TF.title: Cell component of medical device
XE1TF.definition: A component that is designed as a container to collect and/or transfer materials, reagents or specimens.

XE65A.title: Chain component of medical device
XE65A.definition: Assembly of interconnected links, typically made of metal used for connecting other components.

XE6N0.title: Chamber component of medical device
XE6N0.definition: A component designed as a reservoir/storage.

XE4BK.title: Chassis or frame component of medical device
XE4BK.definition: A supporting frame designed to hold other components or devices such as the internal frame of an electronic device.

XE5CL.title: Clutch component of medical device
XE5CL.definition: A component that engages and disengages power transmission.

XE3C8.title: Coating material component of medical device
XE3C8.definition: A layer of material covering the surface of a device.

XE1S0.title: Coil component of medical device
XE1S0.definition: A structure consisting of something wrapped in a continuous series of loops. XE8AQ Helifix coil component of medical device A coil designed to allow a Helifix pacing electrode to be placed in the endocardium.

XE0YX.title: Collimator component of medical device
XE0YX.definition: A diaphragm or system of diaphragms made of an absorbing material, designed to define and restrict the dimensions and direction of a beam of radiation.

XE7YF.title: Concentrator component of medical device
XE7YF.definition: A component designed to increase the weight per unit volume of a substance.

XE5TK.title: Cone component of medical device
XE5TK.definition: A three-dimensional part that tapers smoothly from a flat circular shape at one end to a point at the other end.

XE7EE.title: Connector or coupler component of medical device
XE7EE.definition: A component designed to serve as a link between parts allowing easy disconnection and reconnection when necessary.

XE83L.title: Controller component of medical device
XE83L.definition: A component designed to control or regulate the operation of another device.

XE46J.title: Compressor component of medical device
XE46J.definition: A component that increases the pressure of air or gas.

XE1S2.title: Cover component of medical device
XE1S2.definition: An object designed to conceal, enclose, or protect something.

XE8LZ.title: Cuff component of medical device
XE8LZ.definition: A bandlike structure that encircles a body part or another component or device.

XE8YR.title: Cup component of medical device
XE8YR.definition: Part or design of a device with a concave hemispherical shape.

XE8T8.title: Cusp and leaflet component of medical device
XE8T8.definition: A thin blade-like component, typically used as part of a one-way valve.

XE3LB.title: Cutter or blade component of medical device
XE3LB.definition: A component designed for slicing or cutting.

XE9WL.title: Cylinder component of medical device
XE9WL.definition: A three-dimensional part with flat circular ends and long straight sides.

XE3CX.title: Device collapser component of medical device
XE3CX.definition: A component designed to fold or collapse something.

XE8J5.title: Device deployer component of medical device
XE8J5.definition: A component designed to install something or distribute something in a systematic way.

XE1KD.title: Diaphragm component of medical device
XE1KD.definition: A component consisting of a flexible sheet or partition.

XE85G.title: Dome component of medical device
XE85G.definition: Part or design of a device with a convex hemispherical shape.

XE5K4.title: Ejector component of medical device
XE5K4.definition: A mechanism that pushes a device or component out.

XE1VC.title: Equipment pole component of medical device
XE1VC.definition: A structural component designed to hang medical equipment.

XE8ZU.title: Extender component of medical device
XE8ZU.definition: A component designed to lengthen a structure.

XE8VD.title: Fan or blower component of medical device
XE8VD.definition: A component designed to create an air current through the rotation of a planar surface.

XE5DL.title: Fastner component of medical device
XE5DL.definition: A component designed to hold items in place. XE1A5 Adhesive fastner component of medical device Any substance that affixes 2 or more surfaces together. This may be supplied separately, or attached to another item such as tape. XE4V8 Bolt fastner component of medical device A cylindrical connector element which may have a thread/nut connection to form a fastener. XE4PG Clamp fastner component of medical device A component designed to mechanically hold items firmly together. XE3VN Clip fastner component of medical device A small component designed to hold and attach items together. XE9KR Fixation wire fastner component of medical device A metal strand designed for structural or other purpose. XE6R2 Latch fastner component of medical device A fastening component for a mobile part usually consisting of a bar that is retained in a slot. XE7GP Nail fastner component of medical device A pin-shaped fastener with a sharp point at one end and usually flat on the other end. XE0F0 Nut fastner component of medical device A threaded fastener designed to engage a bolt. XE6A2 Pin fastner component of medical device A small, slender separate component which is designed to secure another object. XE059 Prong fastner component of medical device A projecting pointed part of a device, usually one designed to attach a device to something else. XE33C Retainer fastner component of medical device A physical component designed to hold items in place.

XE15J.title: Fiber component of medical device
XE15J.definition: Any component made from a long, slender material.

XE65M.title: Filter component of medical device
XE65M.definition: A component designed to remove something from whatever passes through it.

XE10F.title: Flange component of medical device
XE10F.definition: A protruding edge designed to strengthen or stabilize a device or facilitate its attachment to a surface.

XE3HQ.title: Gas exchanger component of medical device
XE3HQ.definition: Component that is used to transfer gasses between two or more locations.

XE3QZ.title: Gasket component of medical device
XE3QZ.definition: A preformed material designed to form a seal between connecting surfaces.

XE5M6.title: Gears component of medical device
XE5M6.definition: A toothed wheel designed to mesh with another toothed object and transmit motion.

XE0RK.title: Generator component of medical device
XE0RK.definition: A component designed to produce electricity, vapor or gas.

XE1ND.title: Guide component of medical device
XE1ND.definition: A component designed to help direct the passage of another object.

XE64H.title: Guidewire component of medical device
XE64H.definition: A flexible wire designed to help position medical devices within the body.

XE11W.title: Handpiece component of medical device
XE11W.definition: A part of a device designed to be used while held in the hand.

XE37B.title: Header component of medical device
XE37B.definition: The connection point between the leads and the generator.

XE2AL.title: Sewing ring component of medical device
XE2AL.definition: A ring of supportive material designed to provide a stable surface for attachment to surrounding tissues.

XE12Q.title: Heat exchanger component of medical device
XE12Q.definition: A component designed to transfer heat between fluids and/or gases across a barrier or to the environment.

XE5ZS.title: Hinge component of medical device
XE5ZS.definition: A component designed to join two objects and allow them to swing relative to one another.

XE4FZ.title: Holder component of medical device
XE4FZ.definition: A component designed to hold another object.

XE3A4.title: Hose component of medical device
XE3A4.definition: A flexible tube designed to carry a fluid or gas.

XE5S9.title: Housing component of medical device
XE5S9.definition: A rigid casing that encloses and protects a piece of equipment.

XE0YE.title: Humidifier component of medical device
XE0YE.definition: A component used to increase moisture in a gas.

XE1TK.title: Hydraulic system component of medical device
XE1TK.definition: A system designed to use fluid pressure to bring about movement.

XE4NN.title: Impeller component of medical device
XE4NN.definition: The rotating component of a centrifugal pump, compressor, or other machine designed to move a fluid by rotation.

XE3WA.title: Inserter component of medical device
XE3WA.definition: A component whose function is to facilitate the insertion of a particular device.

XE1Y2.title: Insulation component of medical device
XE1Y2.definition: A material designed to reduce the transmission of heat, sound, or electricity.

XE7JF.title: Isolator component of medical device
XE7JF.definition: Any material or structure designed to limit the interaction between two components.

XE7N3.title: Jaw component of medical device
XE7N3.definition: A component designed to use opposing parts to close on and hold an object.

XE7GQ.title: Joint component of medical device
XE7GQ.definition: A component designed as the junction between objects; it may be flexible or rigid.

XE3AW.title: Knob component of medical device
XE3AW.definition: A rounded lump or ball used for adjusting or controlling.

XE6R7.title: Label component of medical device
XE6R7.definition: Any written, printed, or graphic matter upon a device to identify its nature, ownership, or other characteristics of the device.

XE1VQ.title: Leaflet component of medical device
XE1VQ.definition: A device consisting of two thin blades hinged in the center; typically designed to control flow of fluids.

XE5XR.title: Lever component of medical device
XE5XR.definition: A rigid bar that rotates around a fixed point. XE08E Foot pedal component of medical device A lever designed to be operated with the foot.

XE80W.title: Liner component of medical device
XE80W.definition: A component placed inside the walls of a cavity or container for protection or insulation.

XE17E.title: Magazine or cassette component of medical device
XE17E.definition: A compartment in a device designed to house a consumable material for feeding into a mechanism.

XE87E.title: Manifold component of medical device
XE87E.definition: A compartment in a device designed to house a consumable material for feeding into a mechanism.

XE26U.title: Mask component of medical device
XE26U.definition: A flexible, form-shaped component designed to be placed over the nose and/or mouth.

XE74K.title: Mechanical mixer component of medical device
XE74K.definition: A mechanical component designed to blend materials.

XE9VQ.title: Membrane component of medical device
XE9VQ.definition: A component that is made from or resembles a thin flexible sheet of material acting as a boundary or separating two chambers.

XE8R6.title: Mesh component of medical device
XE8R6.definition: Component made of overlapping strands forming a fine net-like structure.

XE0R5.title: Motor component of medical device
XE0R5.definition: A machine that converts any form of energy to produce or impart motion (kinetic energy).

XE8X1.title: Mount component of medical device
XE8X1.definition: A structural component designed to facilitate the attachment of one object to another.

XE4BH.title: Needle component of medical device
XE4BH.definition: A component with a long, slender, pointed shape.

XE78G.title: Nozzle component of medical device
XE78G.definition: A component designed to regulate and direct the flow of a fluid or gas.

XE7C4.title: Packaging component of medical device
XE7C4.definition: The outer wrapping around a device which serves to contain, identify, and protect it prior to use.

XE5AR.title: Pad component of medical device
XE5AR.definition: Typically a soft, cushion-like material used to prevent injury or damage to a person or device. Can also be made of an absorbent material to absorb liquid.

XE080.title: Panel component of medical device
XE080.definition: A rigid sheet that forms a surface of a device or component.

XE965.title: Plate component of medical device
XE965.definition: A thin, flat sheet or strip used to join, strengthen or to form parts of another structure.

XE09R.title: Plug component of medical device
XE09R.definition: A component designed to seat into an opening in a device or other object.

XE9R2.title: Plunger component of medical device
XE9R2.definition: A component of a machine, tool or device that pushes or thrusts another object, liquid or gas.

XE25A.title: Post component of medical device
XE25A.definition: An upright piece that is fixed firmly that supports, place or aligns other parts. Optical medical device component Component which involves or relates to vision, light, or images.

XE120.title: Camera component of medical device
XE120.definition: An apparatus for taking photographs, generally consisting of a lightproof enclosure having an aperture with a shuttered lens through which the image of an object is focused and recorded on a photosensitive film or plate.

XE5CR.title: Film component of medical device
XE5CR.definition: A photographic material designed to capture an image upon exposure to electromagnetic radiation.

XE7NH.title: Imager component of medical device
XE7NH.definition: A component designed to create or record a visual representation.

XE6GJ.title: Laser component of medical device
XE6GJ.definition: A component designed to emit a monochromatic beam of coherent light.

XE6QH.title: Light emitting diode component of medical device
XE6QH.definition: A type of diode designed to emit light when a current passes through it.

XE616.title: Lenses component of medical device
XE616.definition: An electric or optical component designed to focus (concentrate) or disperse electromagnetic radiation.

XE5LN.title: Light source component of medical device
XE5LN.definition: A component that produces visible light. XE5G9 Bulb component of medical device A component designed to produce light or heat.

XE9EM.title: Mirror component of medical device
XE9EM.definition: A component consisting of a polished surface designed to reflect light.

XE7A6.title: Optical fiber component of medical device
XE7A6.definition: A component made with thin glass fibers as a conduit for transmission of light. Safety medical device component Safety related component

XE28G.title: Alarm component of medical device
XE28G.definition: A component designed to signal the occurrence of a particular event. XE5DW Alarm component of medical device, audible A component designed to signal the occurrence of a particular event by making a sound. XE3WT Alarm component of medical device, visual A component designed to signal the occurrence of a particular event in a way that can be seen.

XE2N6.title: Emergency button or switch component of medical device
XE2N6.definition: A button and circuits designed to force the shutdown of a machine or device.

XE37H.title: Fail-safe system component of medical device
XE37H.definition: A component designed to prevent malfunction, unsafe, or unauthorized operation of a device or system.

XE51V.title: Locking mechanism component of medical device
XE51V.definition: A fastening component designed to hold, close, or secure.

XE8RN.title: Protector or shield component of medical device
XE8RN.definition: A component designed to prevent harm or protect against damage to other components.

XE0ZU.title: Safety interlock component of medical device
XE0ZU.definition: A mechanical or electronic component designed to prevent undesired actions due to the changing state of a device, typically to prevent harm to an operator or damage to the device itself. XE4HV Needle stick prevention mechanism A mechanism integrated into a device to prevent needle stick injuries.

XE58K.title: Safety valve component of medical device
XE58K.definition: A valve designed to automatically open in order to maintain the pressure in a system below a specified pressure. Other component of medical device Terms not yet classified. If these terms get moved to other categories, this category can be deleted. (Previously the device category.)

XE27U.title: Part, component or sub-assembly term not applicable
XE27U.definition: The device does not have distinct parts, components, or sub-assemblies, or it would not be appropriate to link the reported incident to a single part, component, or sub- assembly. Use this term if the problem involves or affects the overall device rather than a specific component.

XE8NG.title: Appropriate term or code not available for medical device component
XE8NG.definition: The parts, components, or sub-assemblies are not adequately described by any other term. Note: this code must not be used unless there is no other feasible code. The preferred term should be documented when submitting an adverse event report. This information will be used to determine if a new term should be added to the code table. Status of intent of death

XE19B.title: Unknown status of cause of death
XE19B.definition: Consciousness Glasgow Coma Scale Eye opening score

XC2N.title: Eyes opening non testable
XC2N.definition: Eyes closed by local factor. Glasgow Coma Scale Motor score

XC03.title: Verbal score non testable
XC03.definition: Factor interfering with communication. Pupil reaction score

XM3T47.title: Sensitizers used in photodynamic or radiation therapy
XM3T47.definition: XM8EW4 Porfimer sodium XM5GF8 Methyl aminolevulinate XM40J3 Aminolevulinic acid XM04X3 Temoporfin XM2BE2 Efaproxiral XM1ER6 Padeliporfin Other antineoplastic drugs Coded Elsewhere: Celecoxib (XM63D2)

XM5A01.title: Holmium-166
XM5A01.definition: Holmium-166 (166Ho) is an isotope for the internal radiation therapy of hepatic malignancies.

XM9QH4.title: Camostat
XM9QH4.definition: Anticoagulant antagonists, vitamin K and other coagulants

XA3JX0.title: Platelet-rich plasma
XA3JX0.definition: Platelet-rich plasma consists of two elements: plasma (the liquid portion of blood) and platelets (a type of blood cells that play an important role in healing throughout the body). Iron and its compounds Coded Elsewhere: Ferric citrate (XM8NS1)

XM6435.title: Sodium dipantoyl ferrate
